title: I trained a 15M "decision-only" model two ways — linear recurrence vs Transformer attention. Accuracy was a coin flip; latency and training cost weren't.[R]
summary: Inspired by TypeSafe's Jev (a non-generative model that only outputs bounded decisions — choices, probabilities, calibrated confidence), I built two small decision models end-to-end on identical budgets and tasks to answer one question: which substrate makes the better Jev? Repo:
reason: Reddit personal experiment comparing recurrence vs attention; no peer-reviewed paper, arXiv preprint, benchmark, official model release, OSS tool announcement, or business/policy event. No rule covers.
